texts.zh: 一大群人来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的人在我们成为他们的附庸后，开始来我们的世界旅行，并对我们的文化和人民表现出兴趣。起初，我们认为这对所有人来说都是一件好事，但近段时间，我们看到当地人和[overlord_empire.GetAdj]游客之间的冲突增加了——他们似乎对我们的帝国怀有一些误解，他们倾向于使用[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的文化和理想为他们的粗野辩护。
texts.en: A large number of people from the [overlord_empire.GetName] started visiting our worlds after we became a subject of theirs, expressing an interest in our culture and people. At first we figured it would be a good thing for all of us, but we see a rise in conflicts between locals and [overlord_empire.GetAdj] visitors as of late - they seem to harbor some misconceptions about our empire, and they tend to use [overlord_empire.GetAdj] culture and ideals to justify their boorishness.

label.zh: 我们两个帝国迟早会共同繁荣。
label.en: Our two empires will learn to thrive together in time.

texts.zh: 我们收到了一些不安的消息，消息的源头是我们前往拜访[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]——[subject_empire.GetName]的首都——的人。[subject_empire.GetName]政权要求他们立刻撤离行星，显然在经过几次所谓的冲突之后，我们的平民在他们的帝国内以不再受欢迎。
texts.en: We have received distressed communications from some of our people who have visited [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], the capital of the [subject_empire.GetName]. The [subject_empire.GetName] regime has instructed them to vacate the planet immediately, as our civilians are apparently no longer welcome in their empire after several alleged conflicts.

label.zh: 边境依然会开放的，无论如何。
label.en: The borders will stay open, one way or another.

label.zh: 如果我们的人民举止不佳，那他们就该回家。
label.en: If our people cannot behave, they stay home.

texts.zh: 看来我们的宗主国听说了这个情况，并派出了一小批官僚和士兵来澄清他们关于此事的立场。他们毫不含糊地明确表示，要么我们和平地向他们的平民开放边界，要么他们将强行让彼此之间的边界开放。
texts.en: It seems our overlord has heard about the situation, and has sent a small contingent of bureaucrats and soldiers to clarify their stance on this. In no uncertain terms they make it clear that we will either open the borders to their civilians peacefully, or they will forcefully keep the borders open between us.

label.en: It is not important enough to fight for.

texts.zh: 看来我们的宗主国听说了这个情况，并选择接受我们对[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的平民旅行关闭边界的决定。我们的一些官员担心这可能会引发外交事件，但这次似乎侥幸避免了。
texts.en: It seems our overlord has heard about the situation, and chosen to accept our decision to close our borders to [overlord_empire.GetAdj] civilian travel. Some of our administrators feared this might spark a diplomatic incident, but it seems to have been narrowly avoided this time.

label.zh: 结果比我们期望的要好得多。
label.en: It worked out better than we could have hoped for.
